name: Prachiti Zemse
title: Fashion Design Student
tagline: Turning abstract ideas into wearable — and functional — design.
about: I'm a fashion design student at NIFT Mumbai, drawn to the space between the abstract and the wearable. I love taking unexpected, sometimes wild ideas and working them through sketches, drapes and fabric until they become real garments — some expressive, some purely functional. I'm looking to learn from experienced designers through internships and mentorship.

education.institute: National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), Mumbai
